subject: Re: Demo for Acme — rescheduling to allow prep
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Jones <sarah.jones@acmeretail.com>
Cc: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-12T09:15:00-08:00
Subject: Demo for Acme — initial scheduling

Hi Sarah,

Thanks again for the time earlier — excited to show how Redwood can help reduce inference costs for Acme's personalization pipeline. Would Thursday, Nov 16 at 10:00 AM PT / 1:00 PM ET work for a 45-minute demo?

High level agenda:
- Quick intros (5m)
- Redwood platform demo focused on embeddings + reranking (25m)
- Q&A + next steps (15m)

To make the session most valuable, could you share a small sample of your workload traces and a representative prompt set (anonymized is fine)? If possible, please grant read access to a sample S3 bucket or a Google Drive folder so we can validate runtimes ahead of time — this helps us tune the demo to your latencies and token profiles.

I'm attaching a short prep packet with suggested prompt sets and the demo agenda. If Nov 16 doesn't work we can shift. Nikhil (copied) will join for technical Q&A.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachment: demo-prompt-sets.pdf

From: Sarah Jones <sarah.jones@acmeretail.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@acmeretail.com>
Date: 2026-11-12T11:07:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Demo for Acme — initial scheduling

Marissa — thanks, and appreciate the detail. Quick heads up: the team is traveling the week of Nov 15 (major store rollout) so Nov 16 is going to be tight for us. Would you be able to move to Nov 18 or the week after? Prefer mornings PT.

Also, we can share a small subset of production traces but need to route the access through our SRE. Can you give a list of the exact permissions/files you'd need so I can get that request queued?

Tom will be joining; I looped him here.

—Sarah
Director, Product Innovation
Acme Retail

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Jones <sarah.jones@acmeretail.com>
Cc: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-13T08:42:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Demo for Acme — rescheduling to allow prep

Thanks for the update, Sarah — totally understand the travel conflict. Nov 18 mornings PT work for us. Would 11:00 AM PT / 2:00 PM ET on Nov 18 be a good option for a 45-minute demo?

Regarding access for prep, here's what our SRE/engineering team needs (minimal, read-only):
- A few representative request logs (gz or csv) covering 5k-20k requests or a 1-2 day sample
- Sample prompt sets (anonymized) or a CSV with prompt templates and typical token counts
- Temporary read-only S3 credentials OR a Google Drive link with viewer access

If it's easier, you can drop the files to Drive and share the link; we'll validate them and run a short pre-demo run to tune batching/quantization recommendations. I'm attaching the prompt set PDF and a small workload trace sample to show the shape of what helps us prepare.

Separately, can we do a quick 30-minute prep sync on Nov 17 at 11:00 AM PT just for alignment (review prompt sets, clarify success metrics, confirm access)? Nikhil and Lauren will join that call.

If that timeline works I'll send calendar invites (prep + demo).

Best,
Marissa
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

Attachments: demo-prompt-sets.pdf; workload-traces-sample.csv

From: Sarah Jones <sarah.jones@acmeretail.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-13T15:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Demo for Acme — rescheduling to allow prep

Marissa / team — Nov 18 at 11:00 AM PT works for the demo, and Nov 17 at 11:00 AM PT for the prep sync is good for us. I've asked SRE to grant read-only access to a Drive folder and will share the link by EOD tomorrow.

Looping Tom: Tom, can you confirm you'll be on both the prep sync and the demo? Also, if there's anything specific you'd like to see (latency SLA modeling, cost per request breakdown), let us know and we can prioritize.

Thanks — we'll wait for your invites.

—Sarah
